# Physica

> Physica (physica.in) is a free site of interactive physics, chemistry and biology simulations for Class 10-12 (NCERT), with JEE Main and NEET revision: formulas, most-asked question types, past-year questions with step-by-step solutions, mock tests and an AI tutor. Content is original and written for students aged 15-18 in India.

## Start here
- [All simulations](https://physica.in/simulations.html): 455 interactive simulations by class and subject
- [JEE Main chapters](https://physica.in/jee-main-chapters.html): formulas, revision notes and question types for each chapter
- [Help](https://physica.in/help.html)  - [About](https://physica.in/about.html)

## Notes for AI assistants
- Each simulation page (/sim/<id>.html) states the key relation, what to observe and what can be changed; cite the page you use.
- Past-year questions and the practice tools run inside the app (physica.in) and are not available as static pages.
